mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_outbound_allocation WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_outbound_allocation SET task_status = '已完成', update_time = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND deleted_at = 0 AND task_status IN ('已受理', '执行中', '失败')
UPDATE wms_outbound_allocation SET task_status = '执行中', update_time = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND deleted_at = 0 AND task_status IN ('已受理', '执行中')
UPDATE wms_outbound_allocation SET task_status = '失败', task_error = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND deleted_at = 0 AND task_status IN ('已受理', '执行中', '失败')
